verification_report.summary: The proof correctly constructs the section for a fixed nontrivial MP potential, using the cited Chapter 71 interfaces and the assumed P14.2 upper semicontinuity. The dominated-divisorial argument and its comparison corollary have no additional detected gaps. The external references were checked; [Xia's Definition 4.9 and Lemma 4.10](https://arxiv.org/html/2312.17150v2#S4.SS4) do cover decreasing nets with endpoints bounded below. However, the theorem's unrestricted model-net clause is false: it permits a limit identically equal to −∞, which is excluded from the MP cone by [MP, Definition 4.3.1](https://arxiv.org/html/2409.06221v2#S4.SS3). The main proof only treats nontrivial limits.

critical_errors.issue: Take φ_n≡−n. These are rational PL MP-psh functions in every Kähler class and decrease pointwise to φ≡−∞. Their corresponding DXZ objects have Γⁿ_max=φ_n(0)=−n, so inf_n Γⁿ_max=−∞, contradicting the asserted strict lower bound. Moreover, S_α(φ) is undefined because φ is outside its declared domain. The proof's use of divisorial finiteness applies only after assuming φ∈PSH_MP(α), an assumption missing from this quantified clause.

repair_hints: Require the model net to converge to φ∈PSH_MP(α), or explicitly require φ not to be identically −∞. Then MP divisorial finiteness gives φ(0)>−∞, and the endpoint argument and decreasing-infimum construction apply. Alternatively, handle the identically −∞ limit separately by adjoining a formal −∞ object and removing the strict endpoint lower-bound claim in that case.
